title: Playschool for Sale in Dubai, UAE
tagline: The beginning of this academic year in September started with 70 child enrolled children, with new registrations continuing throughout the year. Our private nursery has a capacity of 160 children per shift, with the possibility of operating two shifts daily. In addition, we manage a government nursery branch with 50 children under an annual government contract. Across both branches, we currently employ 29 staff members, including management, teachers, teaching assistants, and support staff. We are proud to have a multicultural and inclusive nursery environment, welcoming children and families from approximately 34 different nationalities. Our main focus is to continue increasing enrolment while maintaining high standards of education, child development, safety, and parent satisfaction. Our nursery operates under the supervision and regulations of the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA), Dubai. KHDA Educational Permit.
